positive_observations: Existing runtime_contract verifies exact Connected ROOT, at least one allowed rooted_plants_v1 literal call, exact family.json/raw.png and source hash. Current real consumer is limited and the new adapter does not add all sibling assets as known runtime files.

Actual python3 -B tests/test_quality.py independently completed44 tests in0.580s, exit0. Added cases correctly cover direct dynamic/unknown calls, wrong ROOT, absent files, stale SHA, manifest path escape and false offline claims for the two explicitly known files.

findings.location: tools/check_quality_diff.py known_asset_consumers Connected direct-call scan and exact ROOT literal skip
findings.actual: Additional runtime reads through the newly exempted ROOT constant are accepted without being resolved or marked known. Independent Python temporary-fixture mutation preserved the legitimate original read_family("rooted_plants_v1") and added func hidden_reader(): return FileAccess.get_file_as_string(ROOT+"hidden/family.json"). With an actual hidden/family.json present, known_asset_consumers accepted and returned hidden_in_known=False. Thus that new runtime file can evade the intended runtime-vs-offline consumer classification.
findings.expected: The exception must remain finite: any additional unresolved ROOT-based consumer is rejected rather than accepting a consumer graph wider than the verified manifest/raw pair.
findings.reproduction: Use existing QualityTests.connected_runtime_fixture(); create assets/production_repair/hidden/family.json; append a valid function reading FileAccess.get_file_as_string(ROOT+"hidden/family.json"); invoke known_asset_consumers(root). Current result ACCEPTED, hidden manifest absent from known. This was an independent synthetic Python guard test, not actual GDScript execution.
findings.related_counterexample: Appending func hidden_reader(selection): return call("read_family", selection) also passes the direct-call scan. Direct read_family(selection) is rejected by existing tests, but reflective calls are currently skipped as strings.
findings.minimum_repair: Bound the approved ROOT reference/path-construction forms to the actual finite consumer; reject additional ROOT-based FileAccess/load paths and unknown reflective/aliased family dispatch. It is sufficient to fail closed for unsupported syntax; no general GDScript interpreter is required. Add these two guard-negative mutations and retain the legitimate consumer positive, stale/missing/escape/offline negatives.
findings.impact_limit: No claim current shipped consumer actually reads hidden assets. The defect is in the changed quality guard and its claim to reject new unresolved dynamic consumers.

final_requirement: Preserve this REJECT; author repairs and new frozen source require independent recheck. Existing44 unit passes and236-file PR quality-diff success do not refute these additional counterexamples.
